claim_scores.rationale: It patches `litellm.text_completion` and drives `dspy.LM("openai/demo", model_type="text").forward(...)`, capturing the actual outbound text request path.
It sets conflicting upper-case and provider-specific lower-case env vars, then asserts the first call uses `openai_API_KEY` and `openai_API_BASE` values.
It makes a second call with explicit `api_key` and `api_base` kwargs and asserts those exact explicit values override env-derived ones.
It records and prints captured outbound kwargs including `model` and `prompt`, which exposes the rewritten text model and assembled prompt shape.
